drafts.subject: Re: Integrating byLLM into our product - partnership?
drafts.message:
Hi Chris,

Thank you for reaching out and for your positive feedback on the byLLM proto-type performance; we are thrilled to hear that it exceeded your expectations.

I’d be happy to discuss potential partnership opportunities and collaboration in depth. I suggest setting up a meeting with our Business Development Team. I will connect you with [Name], who can coordinate the meeting schedule and further discuss the potential integration.

Looking forward to exploring this exciting opportunity with you!

Best regards,
[Your Name]

drafts.subject: Re: Prospective GSoC contributor - where to start?
drafts.message:
Hi Fatima,

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Jaseci! It's great to hear that you’re diving into Jac while being comfortable with Python.

To start contributing, I recommend looking at the following repositories:
1. [Repo 1 Name] - It has several beginner-friendly issues labeled as ‘good first issue’.
2. [Repo 2 Name] - You can also check for issues needing attention and submit PRs once you are comfortable.

We also have a GSoC page where we outline potential projects and areas where you can contribute. Let me know if you have any questions or need further assistance.

Best,
[Your Name]

drafts.subject: Re: Bug: edge traversal returns duplicates after node delete (repro attached)
drafts.message:
Hi Omar,

Thank you for your detailed report on the bug regarding edge traversal after node deletion. We appreciate your effort in providing reproducible steps.

This is a known issue, and our development team is currently working on a fix. In the meantime, a potential workaround would be to clear any cached results right after a deletion is performed to prevent stale references. 

Please go ahead and file a full GitHub issue with your findings as it will help us track this issue more effectively. If you need any assistance in filing the issue, feel free to reach out.

Thanks for your understanding and support!

Best,
[Your Name]

drafts.subject: Re: Press: quote on agentic programming languages (deadline Aug 5 EOD)
drafts.message:
Hi Grace,

Thank you for reaching out regarding your article. Here is a quote you can use:

'General-purpose programming languages often struggle to represent the dynamic and context-sensitive nature of agentic systems. Unlike specialized agent-native languages, they may require cumbersome workarounds to facilitate communication between agents and their environment, limiting efficiency and expressiveness.'

Feel free to reach out if you need further clarification or additional quotes. Good luck with your piece!

Best,
[Your Name]

drafts.message:
Hi Hannah,

No worries about the rescheduling! August 19 at 6:30pm works perfectly for me. Thanks for keeping me in the loop, and I’m looking forward to the meetup.

Best,
[Your Name]
